name: A port
title: Mail the author, *without naming a provider*
lede: We mail the author without naming a provider. The handler asks for a mailer, and a class that extends it is enough to provide one.
fig: The handler names the capability; the config, if ever needed, names who answers.
aside: Add FakeMailer extends Mailer and the app refuses to start, naming both classes and the line that settles it: ports: { Mailer: '…' }.
